svg.title: How Willow works, at a glance
svg.desc: Shoppers and brands use one web app on Firebase; willow-api and willow-engine on Cloud Run measure with classical computer vision; Gemini only explains, behind Model Armor and validators; data in Firestore, Cloud Storage and BigQuery in us-central1.
svg.text: Every number from code · Gemini explains, never measures
one React web app, a PWA
daily caps, a line in front of
every number must be in the input;
one retry, then a fixed template
model calls to build a routine
Gemini: global endpoint · everything else us-central1
